edge.title: Per-row u/w floor + post-pin cautious WD; eval-only Tail-EMA readout
edge.summary: Built from #44's script (not #45's) with three levers switched on for the record. RowFloor replaces the scalar u/w floor: each output row of the Muon update whose norm is below 0.3825·‖W_i‖ is scaled up to that target, with no Frobenius renormalization. Cautious Weight Decay multiplies the coordinates the step is already shrinking (U·W > 0) by (1 − lr·0.025) after the radius rescale, so this coordinate-selective shape change is not normalized away by the pin. Tail-EMA becomes an eval-only readout: a τ=150 EMA of non-embedding params kept over steps 2400–2900 is blended 0.4·θ + 0.6·EMA only for a separate val_ema_loss evaluation (weights restored), the 2690 claim is read from that column, and training runs the full 2900-step schedule.

changes.label: RowFloor: per-output-row u/w floor
changes.detail: For 2-D Muon params the scalar floor is replaced: each update row is multiplied by f_i = max(1, 0.3825·‖W_i‖/‖U_i‖)^1.0 with no renorm (ROWFLOOR_FROB=0), after the radial brake; the radius target is then computed from the floored update.

changes.label: Cautious WD 0.025 after radius pin
changes.detail: Mask m = 1[U⊙W > 0] (step shrinks |w|) is taken before p.add_; after rescale_to_radius, W ← W⊙(1 − lr·0.025·m) with lr the scheduled Muon LR; 2-D Muon params only.

changes.label: Tail-EMA → eval-only val_ema readout
changes.detail: The fp32 EMA (τ=150, embed excluded) now runs over steps 2400–2900 (was from 2000) and is never written into the training weights: each validation also logs val_ema_loss on 0.4·θ + 0.6·EMA, then restores θ; the claim uses this column.

changes.label: Full 2900-step run, denser evals
changes.detail: #45's STOP_STEP=2720 truncation and in-place blend are gone (STOP_STEP defaults to 2900); extra_val_steps add every 5th step from 2600.

changes.label: #44 base + default-off research levers
changes.detail: The script is #44's plus ~40 env-gated levers (MARS, SNR masks, PSGD/manifold/schedule-free modes, Shampoo/KL denominators, GroupMuon, Muon+, MuonR, LAWA, BEMA/aniso Tail-EMA, LM-head/spectral init, fork checkpoints), all defaulting to #44 behavior; #45's default-off hooks are absent.

edge.parent_check: Declared parent #45 holds only conceptually: the logged script is #44's code plus env-gated levers (nearest-code #44, c46_p44_nearest.diff) and contains none of #45's code. Tail-EMA was re-implemented (commented 'PR#325 Tail-EMA blend readout') with the same τ=150, λ=0.6 and embed exclusion, but the EMA starts at 2400 instead of 2000, stops updating at 2900, and is applied non-destructively at every validation as val_ema_loss instead of once in place at 2720; #45's STOP_STEP=2720 is not carried over.
edge.noise: About 40 env-gated experimental levers with default-off settings (MARS-M, embed/proj SNR reweighting, SNR mask, PSGD-Kron base, column-manifold mode, KL/Shampoo/late-damp SOAP denominators, tail-frozen Gram β2, GroupMuon, Muon+, MuonR, WALL_DAMP, SV_SHAPE, QK-CM, QK-directional floor, LAWA/RRE, aniso/BEMA/velocity Tail-EMA variants, schedule-free, tail LR splice, LM-head/spectral init, fork checkpointing, UW logging) plus a val_avg_loss column.

mechanisms.name: RowUpdateFloor (per-row u/w floor)
mechanisms.explain: After Newton–Schulz and the radial brake, each 2-D Muon update U is compared row by row with the weight: rows with ‖U_i‖ < 0.3825·‖W_i‖ are scaled up to exactly 0.3825·‖W_i‖ and other rows are left alone (ρ = 1, no Frobenius renormalization), replacing the single matrix-level check ‖U‖F ≥ 0.3825·‖W‖F. The radius target is then computed from the floored update's first-order radial component and the weight is rescaled to it, so the floor mainly reshapes how the step is distributed across output rows.

mechanisms.name: Cautious Weight Decay (post radius pin)
mechanisms.explain: Before the step, the mask m = 1[U⊙W > 0] marks coordinates that W ← W − lr·U moves toward zero; after the step and rescale_to_radius, W ← W⊙(1 − lr·0.025·m), with lr the current PowerCool Muon LR (peak shrink factor 1 − 9.4e-4 per step). Because it is coordinate-selective and applied after the pin, it changes the per-coordinate shape rather than being normalized away; the slight norm reduction carries into the next step's radius target.

caveats: The logged trainer (code/rec_46.py) defaults to TAILEMA_TAU=0, ROWFLOOR=0 (ROWFLOOR_FROB=1) and CWD=0.0, i.e. #44 behavior. The record configuration ROWFLOOR=1 ROWFLOOR_FROB=0 ROWFLOOR_RHO=1.0 CWD=0.025 CWD_POST=1 TAILEMA_TAU=150 TAILEMA_LAMBDA=0.6 comes from the README and is hardcoded in train_gpt_cwd_SOTA.py (checked equivalent by diff). Logs don't print these flags: val_ema_loss diverging from val_loss from step 2500 confirms Tail-EMA, and raw val_loss differs from #44's A40 seed-0 log from step 125 (4.4470 vs 4.4358), consistent with RowFloor/CWD being active (world size also differs, 2 vs 8 GPUs). Runs: 2×A40, n=8. The benchmark README's active-techniques list matches the code but omits the inherited antithetic head-mean CGI pairing in layers 6–11 and implies the embed exclusion is new, though #45 already used scope 'nonembed'; the μ cooldown (2700–2900) cannot affect the 2690 claim.
